description:
STRONGER AND RISKIER: THE SAME OPENING, BUT FOR GOING TO GROUND. Do not test this in the same match as anything else, and do not test it before contact-stagger-interrupt-open.json.

WHAT CHANGES. match::anime::action::FallDown::vf14 (0x143f00d00, shared by FallDown kind 0x11 and Dive kind 0x0f) is the same shape as the stagger gate: it returns 1 only when the animation's current frame has reached a key frame taken from the animation's own type-5 event data. Its refuse default is 'xor r14b,r14b' at 0x143f00d1d; this pack makes it 'mov r14b,1', so a player who has been put on the floor may start a new action from frame 0.

HOW IT WAS DEMONSTRATED (a-EMULATED, this pass). FallDown::vf14 run under Unicorn on the INSTALLED image with the same six anime-data callees stubbed. Requesting kinds {Move, Dribble, Trap, Sliding, Tackle, Block, Stagger, Feint, Reaction, Dodge, Jostle, GK-Catch} x currentFrame {0,10,29,30,60} with keyFrame 30: STOCK returns 0 at frames 0/10/29 and 1 at 30/60, for every kind. The function is byte-for-byte the same code as Sliding::vf14 (0x143f70360) except for one compare constant, and that sibling's default flip is already a proven, written spec.

WHY IT IS FILED AS RISKY. Getting up off the floor is a physical event, not a decision - a man who has been dumped SHOULD lose a beat, and that is most of the weight you asked for when you asked for more falls. Opening this gate lets a grounded player start acting before the get-up has played, which can read on screen as a player scrambling up unnaturally fast or clipping through the get-up animation. Also note which requests can actually use it: with FallDown current, only Trap (kind 7) delegates - Dribble, Move, Feint, Tackle, Sliding, Reaction, Block and the Contact family are all refused by their own vf2 first, so on its own this pack buys you "stretch for the ball while on the deck" and nothing else. Combined with contact-move-out-of-stagger.json (which also re-aims FallDown into Move's delegate window) it additionally buys "get up and run".

WHO IT AFFECTS: EVERYONE.

IT DOES NOT CHANGE HOW OFTEN ANYONE FALLS. No collision test, contact score or stagger-versus-falldown decision is touched.

EXPECTED EFFECT ON FOULS AND CARDS: NONE.

WHAT WOULD MEAN IT IS TOO STRONG. Players popping up off the ground instantly; falls that stop looking like falls. That is exactly the failure this pack risks, which is why it is ranked below the stagger one.

COLLISIONS: none. 0x143f00d1d is 4532F6 in both the INSTALLED image and eFootball.exe.PRISTINE (verified this pass). Note it is the SAME CODE SHAPE as falls-slide-tackle-contact.json's site (0x143f7037d) but a different function and a different address; the two do not overlap.

REVERT: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/contact-falldown-interrupt-open.json

patches.name: a grounded player (FallDown / Dive) is no longer immune to starting a new action
patches.note: xor r14b,r14b -> mov r14b,1 inside FallDown::vf14 (0x143f00d00, also used by Dive). r14b is the refuse default, written once here and read once at 0x143f00dc8 ('movzx ecx,r14b' then 'cmovge ecx,edx(=1)'). Same length. Site byte-identical in PRISTINE and the installed exe.
